description: You are a foodborne disease epidemiologist at a state health department working with CDC FoodNet surveillance data. A pre-processed Salmonella surveillance dataset has been created for you at C:\Users\Docker\salmonella_surveillance.mdb (table: SalmonellaCases) from real CDC FoodNet annual summary data. The dataset contains columns: Year, Serotype, State, CaseCount, IncidenceRate, AgeGroup, Sex. Your tasks are: (1) Read the SalmonellaCases table into Classic Analysis. (2) Run FREQ analyses on Serotype, State, AgeGroup, and Sex to understand the distribution of cases. (3) Use MEANS to compute average incidence rates by State. (4) Use TABLES to compare case counts across the most common serotypes. (5) Use SELECT to filter to specific years (e.g., SELECT Year>=2015) and run trend analyses. (6) Compute a summary of which serotype-state combinations have the highest burden using SORT and FREQ with stratification. (7) Save ALL output to C:\Users\Docker\salmonella_surveillance_report.html using ROUTEOUT REPLACE. (8) Write a serotype-by-state summary table to C:\Users\Docker\salmonella_serotype_summary.csv. This simulates the annual surveillance report preparation that state epidemiologists do for CDC reporting.

metadata.data_source: CDC FoodNet Annual Summary Data (real surveillance data)
